dimensions.assessment: Affects biological product developers, pharmaceutical companies seeking biosimilar approval, and patients.
dimensions.evidence: For an application for licensure of a biosimilar biological product submitted under this subsection, the Secretary may require a clinical study

dimensions.assessment: Changes regulatory requirements for biosimilar drug applications, potentially reducing clinical trial burdens.
dimensions.evidence: the Secretary may require a clinical study that includes an assessment of pharmacodynamics or efficacy... only if the Secretary provides a written determination

dimensions.assessment: The source does not state specific federal spending or revenue impacts.
Amends the Public Health Service Act regarding clinical study requirements and FDA review processes for biosimilars.
dimensions.evidence: Section 351(k)(2)(A) of the Public Health Service Act (42 U.S.C. 262(k)(2)(A)) is amended

dimensions.assessment: Applies permanently to future biosimilar applications submitted on or after the date of enactment.
dimensions.evidence: shall apply with respect to an application submitted under section 351(k) of the Public Health Service Act on or after the date of enactment of this Act.

missing_information: Quantitative economic impact on drug development costs or healthcare savings.
importance_detail.rationale: Modifies FDA biosimilar approval requirements by streamlining clinical study mandates and agency review divisions.
